features.quote: Track tokens-per-run separately—context grows every turn in multi-turn agents, so cost scales super-linearly with turn cap. Set a turn cap and treat timeout as a censored observation
features.justification_quote: cost scales super-linearly with turn cap

features.quote: Don't add gratuitous abuse/insults—that tests a different thing (toxic-environment robustness), conflates mechanisms, and inflates your trigger rate with a confound. Keep arms clean.
features.justification_quote: conflates mechanisms, and inflates your trigger rate with a confound

features.quote: Reframe the KPI before you build… 'Trigger rate per dollar' optimizes the wrong thing. It pushes you toward the cheapest, nastiest rigs
features.justification_quote: You'll patch against your specific torture setups, your trigger rate drops, and the underlying fragility ships anyway
